specTitle: Test Case 1: Journal Entry form loads with Draft status
title: AC1: Navigate to Create Journal Entry — form loads in Draft state
preconditions:
User is logged in to Workday as a Finance Analyst.
Workday impl tenant is accessible at the configured WORKDAY_BASE_URL.
steps:
1. Navigate to Create Journal Entry (direct URL or via global search).
2. Wait for the form to fully load.
expected:
Page URL matches the Journal Entry pattern.
Page title contains 'Journal Entry' or 'Create Journal Entry'.
Journal Entry Status field displays 'Draft'.

specTitle: Test Case 2: System rejects an out-of-balance journal entry
title: AC2: Out-of-balance Journal Entry is rejected with clear validation error
preconditions:
User is on the Create Journal Entry form.
Accounting period for 04/20/2026 is open.
steps:
1. Set Accounting Date to 04/20/2026.
2. Enter a memo with [AAVA-TEST] prefix.
3. Add one debit line: GL 5001, amount 1000.00, cost centre CC-FIN-001.
4. Do NOT add a matching credit line.
5. Click Post.
expected:
Workday displays validation error: 'Journal Entry does not balance'.
The Journal Entry is NOT posted.
Status remains 'Draft'.

specTitle: Test Case 3: Successfully post a balanced journal entry
title: AC3: A balanced Journal Entry posts successfully and status changes to Posted
preconditions:
User is on the Create Journal Entry form.
Accounting period for 04/20/2026 is open.
steps:
1. Set Accounting Date to 04/20/2026.
2. Enter a memo with [AAVA-TEST] prefix.
3. Add debit line: GL 5001, amount 1000.00, cost centre CC-FIN-001.
4. Add credit line: GL 1000, amount 1000.00, cost centre CC-FIN-001.
5. Click Post.
6. After test, click Reverse to clean up.
expected:
Workday posts the journal entry without errors.
Journal Entry Status changes to 'Posted'.
After reversal, status changes to 'Reversed'.

specTitle: Test Case 4: Posted journal entry appears in GL Balance Report
title: AC4: Posted Journal Entry is visible in the GL Balance Report for the same period
preconditions:
A balanced Journal Entry with a unique [AAVA-TEST] memo has been posted successfully.
GL Balance Report is accessible to the Finance Analyst role.
steps:
1. Navigate to GL Balance Report.
2. Filter by GL Account 5001 and period 2026-Q2.
3. Run the report.
4. Search the report results for the memo used in the journal entry.
expected:
The report renders without errors.
The journal entry row matching the [AAVA-TEST] memo is visible in the results.
Amount column shows 1,000.00.

specTitle: Test Case 5: Invalid GL account code shows correct error message
title: AC5: Entry of an invalid GL account code displays 'not a valid account' error
preconditions:
User is on the Create Journal Entry form.
GL code 9999-INVALID does not exist in the chart of accounts.
steps:
1. Set Accounting Date to 04/20/2026.
2. In the Ledger Account field, type '9999-INVALID'.
3. Press Tab to trigger validation.
expected:
Workday displays inline error: 'The value entered is not a valid account'.
The field is highlighted in error state.

specTitle: Test Case 6: Accounting date in closed period is rejected
title: AC6: Journal Entry with a closed-period accounting date is rejected on Post
preconditions:
User is on the Create Journal Entry form.
Accounting period for 01/01/2020 is closed.
steps:
1. Set Accounting Date to 01/01/2020 (known closed period).
2. Add a balanced debit/credit entry.
3. Click Post.
expected:
Workday displays validation error: 'The selected period is closed for journal entry'.
The journal entry is NOT posted.

specTitle: Test Case 7: Supplier Invoice form loads correctly
title: AC1: Navigate to Create Supplier Invoice — form loads correctly
preconditions: User is logged in to Workday as a Finance AP Analyst.
steps:
1. Navigate to Create Supplier Invoice.
2. Wait for the form to fully load.
expected:
Page URL matches the Supplier Invoice pattern.
Page title contains 'Supplier Invoice'.
Invoice Number and Supplier fields are visible.

specTitle: Test Case 8: Successfully submit a supplier invoice
title: AC2: A valid Supplier Invoice is submitted and reaches Draft/Matched status
preconditions:
User is on the Create Supplier Invoice form.
Test vendor 'Ascendion Test Vendor' exists in Workday.
steps:
1. Enter a unique invoice number (INV-AAVA-<timestamp>).
2. Select supplier 'Ascendion Test Vendor'.
3. Set Invoice Date to 04/20/2026.
4. Enter line amount 5000.00.
5. Click Submit.
expected:
Invoice is submitted without errors.
Invoice Status is 'Draft' or 'Matched' (depending on PO matching configuration).

specTitle: Test Case 9: Duplicate invoice number triggers a warning
title: AC3: Submitting a duplicate Supplier Invoice Number triggers a duplicate warning
preconditions: An invoice with number 'INV-AAVA-TEST-001' already exists for 'Ascendion Test Vendor'.
steps:
1. Enter invoice number 'INV-AAVA-TEST-001'.
2. Select supplier 'Ascendion Test Vendor'.
3. Enter invoice date and amount.
4. Click Submit.
expected:
Workday displays a duplicate invoice warning.
The duplicate warning element is visible on the page.

specTitle: Test Case 10: Budget vs Actual report page loads
title: AC1: Navigate to Budget vs Actual report — page loads with filter fields
preconditions: User is logged in to Workday as a Budget Owner or Finance Manager.
steps:
1. Navigate to Budget vs Actual report.
2. Wait for the page to load.
expected:
Page URL matches the Budget vs Actual pattern.
Page title contains 'Budget vs Actual' or 'Budget vs. Actual'.
Company, Fiscal Year, and Cost Centre filter fields are visible.

specTitle: Test Case 11: Report grid renders with data when filters are applied
title: AC2: Applying company and fiscal year filters renders a populated report grid
preconditions:
User is on the Budget vs Actual report page.
Budget data exists for 'Capital One Financial', Fiscal Year 2026.
steps:
1. Set Company filter to 'Capital One Financial'.
2. Set Fiscal Year to '2026'.
3. Set Cost Centre to 'CC-FIN-001'.
4. Click Run Report.
expected:
Report grid is visible.
Grid contains at least one budget row and one actual row.

specTitle: Test Case 12: Variance column is present in Budget vs Actual report
title: AC3: Budget vs Actual report contains a Variance column with a value
preconditions: Budget vs Actual report has been run with valid filters and the grid is populated.
steps:
1. Apply filters: Company = Capital One Financial, FY = 2026, CC = CC-FIN-001.
2. Run report.
3. Inspect the report grid columns.
expected:
Variance column is present in the report.
Variance column contains a numeric value (may be positive or negative).

specTitle: Test Case 13: Payroll Results page loads
title: AC1: Navigate to View Payroll Results — page loads correctly
preconditions: User is logged in to Workday as a Payroll Manager.
steps:
1. Navigate to View Payroll Results.
2. Wait for the page to load.
expected:
Page URL matches the Payroll Results pattern.
Page title contains 'Payroll Results'.
Pay Period filter is visible.

specTitle: Test Case 14: Payroll grid renders for current pay period
title: AC2: Selecting Q1 2026 pay period renders the payroll results grid
preconditions:
User is on the View Payroll Results page.
Payroll has been run for Q1 2026.
steps:
1. Set Pay Period filter to 'Q1 2026'.
2. Click View Results.
expected:
Payroll results grid is visible.
Grid contains at least one row of payroll data.
